provenance.basis: Four nearest source settlement positions plus a deterministic minimum-distance component backbone; undirected teaching links expanded explicitly to both directed arcs; no claim of actual physical road connection
provenance.backboneRule: minimum-distance spanning links between initial neighbour components, stable ID tie break, respecting the 120km link cap
provenance.detourFormula: round(1.2 + min(0.6, median nearest settlement distance km / 30), 2)
provenance.speedRule: drive 45 below 3km median neighbour distance; 40 below 10km; otherwise 35; teaching parameters
provenance.userOverride: Student game: performance, clarity and engaging decisions can take precedence over scientific precision
provenance.mapRoads: Separate source-backed OSM visual overlay; this teaching graph must not be presented as observed road geometry
limits: Weather, ferries, turn restrictions and entrances are simplified
Same location and coordinate outliers retained; long isolated points remain locally serviceable
Observed source demand is not replaced by map clusters
